links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT-5 heart failure management responses with ESC and ACC/AHA/HFSA guidelines
links.effect: Of 38 responses, 20 (53%) fully concordant, 4 (11%) partially concordant, 8 (21%) discordant, 6 (16%) unsafe/harmful; errors included omission of GDMT and incomplete device therapy recommendations.
links.quote: Of the 38 responses, 20 (53%) were fully concordant, 4 (11%) partially concordant, 8 (21%) discordant, and 6 (16%) unsafe/harmful.

screen.reason: The study tests the guideline concordance and safety of an LLM on clinical vignettes without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
